thread:
sara_sales: Hey team — POC kickoff with LATAM retailer tomorrow. They pinned model `redwood-pegasus-v1.2` but infra says model not available in `sa-east-1`. Is there a recommended fallback? Also they asked about implications for pricing if we route cross-region.

devin_se: Do we have the exact error from their requests? 429 vs 404 matters.

sara_sales: Attached snippet from their logs: 
```
POST /v1/generate
{ model: "redwood-pegasus-v1.2", region: "sa-east-1" }
-> 404 ModelNotFound: model not available in region
```

mike_infra: Confirmed — pegasus v1.2 isn't replicated to `sa-east-1`. Options: (1) route to `us-east-1`/`sa-east-1` equivalent with cross-region egress (latency + egress cost), (2) use a compatible variant we host in `sa-east-1` (e.g., `redwood-pegasus-lite-v1` / quantized), or (3) spin up Dedicated capacity in `sa-east-1` under an enterprise commit (lead time).

ryan_solution: For POC speed, option 2 is usually best — pick the compatible variant, call it out in notes re: perf differences. We can add a compatibility header so app knows it's a fallback.

anita_security: Data residency question — if requests route cross-region, customer data flows out of LATAM. They asked for guarantees: we need to offer either (a) Private deployment (VPC) in region or (b) Dedicated with contractual egress terms + KMS in their region.

sara_sales: Customer is sensitive to data leaving region. They requested a security questionnaire answer for "no cross-border transfer for PII". What's our position?

anita_security: We can't promise no cross-border unless we deploy private/dedicated in-region. For the POC we can offer redaction + pseudonymization guidance, or host a short-term Dedicated trial in `sa-east-1` (requires billing commit). I'll draft an SQ response but need legal sign-off for any exception.

devin_se: Technically, for the fallback variant, I can add a header `x-rw-model-fallback: true` and return which model was used. Also we should log token counts to show cost delta. Sample request patch: 
```
PATCH /v1/route-prefs
{ "prefer_region": "sa-east-1", "fallbacks": ["redwood-pegasus-lite-v1", "redwood-pegasus-v1.1"] }
```

mike_infra: Note about pricing: cross-region requests will incur egress charges on cloud provider + slightly higher per-request due to network hop. For Dedicated in-region we can quote a short-term trial price (discounted commit) — sales, ping me offline for numbers.

ryan_solution: Also call out model quality variance to the customer: lite quantized will be cheaper but maybe noisier on specific prompts. Recommend we run a small eval set and show side-by-side outputs — quick A/B for 50 prompts should be enough.

sara_sales: They also asked about model pinning: will a pinned model automatically roll forward if the version is deprecated? They want guarantees for the POC duration.

devin_se: Pinning behavior: if you pin `redwood-pegasus-v1.2` and we deprecate it mid-POC, alerts are sent and auto-fallback will kick if configured. Default is to reject requests with deprecation error unless `allow_fallback` is set. So we can guarantee no silent rollforward if they opt for strict pin.

anita_security: From a compliance stance, explicit fallsbacks must be documented in the SQ. If we do cross-region fallback, include what data is shared, for how long, and retention policy.

ops_bot: capacity-alert: No replication jobs scheduled for `redwood-pegasus-v1.2` to sa-east-1. If Dedicated requested, provisioning lead time ~48-72 hrs for small pool.

sara_sales: Action items: 1) Devin to add fallback header + sample route patch for app (devin). 2) Mike to send trial Dedicated pricing for sa-east-1 (mike). 3) Ryan to run 50-prompt A/B between `pegasus-v1.2` (us-east) and `pegasus-lite-v1` (sa-east) and post summary (ryan). 4) Anita to draft SQ language about cross-border fallback and short-term mitigations (anita).

devin_se: I'll post the route-prefs snippet and a quick client-side toggle today.

mike_infra: Pricing DM sent to sara_sales.

ryan_solution: I'll spin up the eval and drop CSV results in this thread by EOD.

anita_security: Draft ready — will share for legal review, cc: @legal.

sara_sales: Thanks all — keeping customer updated now. :thumbsup:
